sources.entry: Soduto - Soduto is a KDEConnect compatible application for macOS. It gives AirDrop like integration and allows file and clipboard sharing between your phones, desktops and tablets.

summary.one_liner: Soduto is a KDEConnect-compatible app for macOS that links phones, desktops and tablets, but the original project is no longer under development.
summary.what_it_does: Soduto is a macOS application that is compatible with KDE Connect, and the README says it allows better integration between phones, desktops and tablets. The README's listing in the awesome-list describes it as offering AirDrop-like integration with file and clipboard sharing. The README itself does not detail specific features beyond that. It can be installed from the project website as a .dmg file, or through an unofficial Homebrew cask. The README also covers building it from source in Xcode, with git submodules and Homebrew dependencies (libtool, automake). It includes debugging instructions for adjusting the log level and viewing logs in Console.app.
use_cases: share files between mac and phone
how_to_run: Download Soduto.app from soduto.com, open the .dmg, and drag Soduto.app into Applications
Build from source: install Homebrew, then install libtool and automake: brew install libtool automake
Open Soduto.xcodeproj in Xcode and build the Soduto target
notable: KDE Connect compatible protocol on macOS
Shares files and clipboard between devices
Configurable log level via macOS defaults
caveats: Original project is no longer under development; the README points to forks instead
The README warns that Soduto may access a lot of private data, so users should judge whether to trust fork developers
Verbose logging may write sensitive data such as copied passwords in plain text
